puzzles.title: Awakening the Clockwork Guardian
puzzles.description: The guardian stands motionless before the flooded sluice canal. Its brass gear-wheels need an exact sequence of movement commands to reach the activation crystal.
puzzles.hint: Instruction order matters in the physical world! Step two paces ahead into the hallway, pivot right toward the altar, then take your final stride.

python_reveal.explanation: In Python, instructions execute one line at a time from top to bottom. Swapping lines changes the destination entirely!
python_reveal.code_snippet:
# Guiding the Clockwork Sentinel
move_forward()
move_forward()
turn_right()
move_forward()

print("Guardian reaches the activation crystal!")

puzzles.title: The Sylvan Runic Gateway
puzzles.description: The moss-covered doorway will only unseal if the bearer carries the Emerald Seal of Concord. Otherwise, you must search the ancient roots.

available_options.label: Present the Emerald Seal to the runes (if has_seal: open_gate())
Try to force the massive stone doors without checking conditions
Ignore the lock and assume the gate is already unlocked

puzzles.hint: Doors evaluate conditions: IF the condition is met, take the path; ELSE, take an alternate route.

python_reveal.explanation: Conditions allow software to make decisions dynamically based on whether a statement evaluates to True or False.
python_reveal.code_snippet:
# The Runic Gatekeeper
has_emerald_seal = True

if has_emerald_seal:
    open_portal()
    print("The ancient archway glows and unseals.")
else:
    search_for_seal()
    print("The gate remains dormant stone.")

puzzles.title: The Resonating Conduit of Five Tiles
puzzles.description: To power the reservoir pumps, five identical crystalline tiles must be energized in sequence. Instead of manually carving five separate commands, channel a continuous repetitive loop.
puzzles.hint: When performing the exact same action multiple times, repetitive commands are consolidated into a loop.

python_reveal.explanation: A loop repeats a block of code a specified number of times without having to duplicate lines.
python_reveal.code_snippet:
# Energizing the five resonance tiles
for step in range(5):
    energize_tile(step)
    print(f"Tile {step + 1}/5 harmonized with life energy!")

print("The reservoir pump activates at full power!")
